Maya: Heads up — ops:deployers asked for a delegated service account (svc-deployer-redwood) to let CI run prod deploys. We need an approval flow, least-priv policy, and clear audit hooks. Who should sign off?

Julian: What's the exact scope they want? Tag pushes only or ability to run migrations/scale?

Liam: We should limit it to artifact promotion + manifest apply. No DB migrations. If they need migrations, require a human step.

Sophia: Agree. Also prefer short-lived credentials (1h) issued from our KMS + token broker. Add repo allowlist and IP egress restriction if possible.

Maya: Good. Ops asked for automated runs for scheduled rollouts (canary -> prod). They said 2 repos: infra/prod-manifests and services/payment.

Priya: Approvers: product-sre lead + release eng. I'll approve once we have an audit plan and emergency fallback.

Liam: Emergency fallback: on-call should be able to run a one-time human-signed deploy with the deployer role, recorded in the incident log. Maybe a `--human-override` flag guarded by MFA and a short justification.

Sophia: We can implement that by having deploy-bot require an OAuth exchange that validates an MFA assertion. Practically: human runs `deploy-bot run --override` -> redirect to SSO to complete MFA, then the bot issues a one-time grant.

Julian: Ops-bot created a ticket: ENG-3456 for this. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3456 :ticket:

ops-bot: Ticket ENG-3456 created by Maya: "delegated svc account for CI prod deploys". Initial checklist item added.

Maya: Policy snippet proposal (very rough):
```
{
  "statement": [
    { "action": ["deploy:promote","deploy:apply"], "resource": ["arn:rw:deploy:prod/*"], "effect": "allow" },
    { "action": ["deploy:migrate"], "effect": "deny" }
  ]
}
```

Liam: Add mandatory tags on any deploy from the svc account: `ci_run_id`, `pipeline`, and `initiator_repo`. Those get exported to tracing and Cost dashboard.

Sophia: Audit: every token mint + deploy request should emit an event to our audit-log S3 and trigger a lightweight notice in #eng-releases with masked details. Retain logs 1 year by default for enterprise compliance.

Priya: For approval flow: engineering manager + release eng must approve in the ticket. Once approved, we do a staged enable: sandbox -> staging -> prod over 48h, with manual gate between each.

Maya: Can we require signed checksums on artifacts before the svc account promotes them? Prevents someone swapping manifests.

Julian: Yes — promote only from artifacts with a specific provenance tag and verify signatures in the broker.

Liam: One more: rotate the service account key every 7 days and revoke immediately if any suspicious activity (>=3 failed MFA override attempts or unusual deploy volume).

Sophia: I'll draft the implementation doc and IAM policy, include the token lifecycle diagram and sample logs. Will post PR to ENG-3456.

Maya: Thanks. Action items: - Sophia: implementation doc + IAM policy (PR to ticket) - Liam: add audit log schema + telemetry contract - Priya: formal approval once doc is ready - Julian: confirm migration ban enforcement in CI pipelines - Ops: schedule staged enable window (48h)

Priya: I'll schedule the approval meeting for tomorrow 11am PT. Please add any blockers to the ticket before then. :calendar:
